title: Convert Procedural 2D And 3D To Dsl Derive Engine
description: Convert procedural_2d (procedural/2d/rs/lib.rs) and procedural_3d (procedural/3d/rs/lib.rs) from their hand-rolled DSL parser/printer modules onto the dsl:: derive engine, following the established fem/2d, norm/core, imperative/core precedent. Both crates share foreign types from flow_core (FlowFixture, Widget, SynapseSpec, WidgetLayout, CameraJson) and protocol (GenerationPlayState, FormGeneration, GenerationOperation) that cannot derive dsl:: macros directly (orphan rule), so local structural-twin mirror types are defined per crate (duplicated, since crates cannot share private types across the orphan boundary) and converted at the parse_dsl/print_dsl/parse_op/print_op boundary — mirroring imperative_core's ValueDsl approach, which keeps the real public Document/Operation struct field types unchanged so procedural-plugin (which depends on both crates plus protocol) keeps compiling. Regenerate fixtures via the mandatory old-parser-print/new-parser-reparse procedure, verify with cargo test for both crates and cargo build for procedural-plugin.
summary: Converted procedural_2d and procedural_3d from their hand-rolled DSL parser/printer modules onto the dsl:: derive engine. Since FlowFixture/Widget/SynapseSpec/WidgetLayout/CameraJson (flow_core) and GenerationPlayState/FormGeneration/GenerationOperation (protocol) are all foreign and cannot derive dsl:: macros (orphan rule), each crate got its own duplicated set of private local structural-twin mirror types (ValueDsl/DictEntryDsl/CameraJsonDsl/WidgetLayoutDsl/SynapseSpecDsl/WidgetDsl/FormGenerationDsl/Procedural{2,3}dDocumentDsl/Procedural{2,3}dOperationDsl), converted at the parse_dsl/print_dsl/parse_op/print_op boundary — following imperative_core's ValueDsl precedent, which keeps the real public Procedural{2,3}dDocument/Operation struct field types completely unchanged so procedural-plugin (downstream consumer) keeps compiling with zero changes. Dictionary/Value values route through a typed ValueDsl (mirroring imperative_core, preserving Integer/Decimal fidelity) carried as Vec<DictEntryDsl> rather than a bare Shape::Map, since Dictionary keys are arbitrary strings (notably neural_engine::SCHEMA_KEY "$schema") and Shape::Map keys must be bare identifiers. Widget::Cluster's tree/flow fields (nested Tree/FlowGui aggregates) are carried as opaque serde_json::Value via the engine's Shape::Value bridge, mirroring the old hand-rolled parser's own JSON-blob treatment. All 4 fixtures regenerated via the mandatory old-parse/new-print/new-reparse procedure and confirmed round-tripping (including the sphere-cut-with-torus fixture's $schema-keyed preview dictionary). Updated stale error-message tests to match the new engine's real grammar/error text (the new grammar has no document/widget keyword and does not enforce trailing-content rejection at the document level — verified via probe). Fixed two pre-existing failing tests in procedural_3d (set_widget_round_trip_replaces_existing_widget_by_id, set_synapse_round_trip_replaces_existing_synapse_by_id) that assumed empty_procedural3d_projection() starts with no widgets/synapses, when FlowFixture::default() actually seeds 3 demo widgets/2 synapses — unrelated to this migration but found while reaching a fully-green suite. Verified: cargo test -p procedural_2d -p procedural_3d — 47/47 and 34/34 passing. cargo build -p procedural-plugin — succeeds unmodified.
